sections.heading: Training calendar
sections.lead: Free training, open to any registered or registering group.

body: All training is free. Bring two people from your group where possible — knowledge that sits with one person leaves when that person does.

items.title: Group books a treasurer can actually keep
items.body: A practical day on contribution records, cash books and the monthly statement a bank will ask for. Bring your existing notebook, however untidy.

items.title: Running a meeting, and settling a disagreement
items.body: Chairing, minute-taking, elections and the dispute process every constitution should have before it is needed.

items.title: Before you borrow: what a group loan really costs
items.body: Interest, fees, guarantees, what happens when a member defaults, and how to decide as a group whether to borrow at all.

items.title: Selling to institutions: tenders and LPOs
items.body: What a purchase order is, what compliance a buyer will require, and how a group finances fulfilment.

items.title: Internal dispute resolution — intake
items.body: First session of the dispute-resolution training run with the National Judiciary Mediation Department, part of our regulatory & administrative Results work. Places limited; apply early.

sections.body: Dates are indicative and confirmed by SMS a week before. To book, call **0709 000 000** or ask your field officer. If travel is the obstacle, tell us — we run sessions in sub-counties on request when enough groups ask.
